in_arabic.name: كمالون
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعود أصل الكلمة إلى الكلمة العربية القديمة كمال، والتي تعني الكمال المطلق، وتستخدم في القرآن الكريم في بعض الأيات، مثل قوله تعالى: (فَأَنتُمُ الأَعلىُ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَأَنْتُمُ السَّيِّئُونَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ) [المائدة: 53].

in_urdu.name: كمالون
in_urdu.meaning: عالی درجہ کی قوت اور مطلق کمال
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کے پس منظر میں عرب کی قدیم لسانی روایات اور اسلامی روایات کا کردار ہے، جس کا تعلق کمال کے لفظ سے ہے، جو مطلق کمال کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اسے کئی مسلمانوں کے لیے بہت اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: कमालुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम कमालुन का पृष्ठभूमि इस्लामी धर्म और अरबी भाषा की प्राचीन परंपराओं से जुड़ी हुई है, जिसका मूल अर्थ है 'उच्चतम स्तर' अथवा 'मजबूती', जिसमें इसका संबंध अरबी भाषा के मूल शब्द कमाल से है, जिसका अर्थ है 'सबसे श्रेष्ठ' अथवा 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ', इसका इस्तेमाल कुरआन में भी किया गया है, जैसे कि प्रश्न 5:53 में.

The name is mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to the highest level of spiritual achievement, as mentioned in verse 5:53.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Kamalun" is derived from the Arabic language and carries a rich cultural significance. The root word "kamil" means "perfect" or "complete," emphasizing the importance of striving for excellence and self-improvement in ones' actions, character, and deeds. The name "Kamalun" provides a daily reminder for individuals to continually work towards becoming the best version of themselves in various aspects of life, including relationships, career, and personal growth. This is especially crucial in Islamic culture, which places a strong emphasis on the spiritual and moral development of individuals. As a result, the name "Kamalun" can be seen as an inspiration and motivation for self-assessment and improvement.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name "Kamalun" can be found in the concept of "Tawhid," where the belief is that there is only one God and that we, as humans, must aspire to embody His perfect characteristics. The name "Kamalun" not only serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal of striving towards God-consciousness but also encourages an individual to consider the significance of each action in one's life in relation to their journey towards spiritual growth and closeness to their Creator. The Islamic teachings emphasize the importance of inner transformation, leading to a state of "Fana," where the self is annihilated, and one merges with God. Therefore, the name "Kamalun" represents the aspiration for an individual to actively pursue the path towards unity and closeness with their Creator, striving for perfection and excellence in all aspects of life.
